fullPassage:
The above graph shows who Australian girls and boys aged eleven consulted if they had problems. Mothers were the most consulted source if girls and boys had problems. For boys, fathers were the second most consulted source, followed by friends. The percentage of girls who consulted teachers was 20 percentage points lower than that of girls who consulted fathers. The percentage of boys who consulted teachers was higher than that of girls who consulted teachers by 4 percentage points. More girls went to their friends than to their brothers or sisters if they had problems.

The graph above shows trends in advertising revenue by media type from 2005 to 2013. Between 2005 and 2007, the amount of advertising revenue earned by newspapers was the largest among the five media types. However, the newspaper ad revenue had continuously dropped since 2005 and ranked the second from the bottom in 2013, next to the ad revenue of radio. Since 2005, the Internet ad revenue had noticeably increased, and in 2013 it surpassed the previously leading ad revenue source, broadcast TV. The ad revenue of cable TV had increased steadily since 2005 and became a little less than twice that of radio in 2009. Between 2009 and 2013, unlike the other four media types, the radio ad revenue changed little, remaining around 15 billion dollars.

The above graph shows the different education levels by trade occupations in Canada in 2006. Electricians had the highest proportion of registered apprenticeship certificates among the given five trades. The highest proportion of certificates was held by hairstylists and barbers, with their combined proportion of registered apprenticeship certificates and other trade certificates reaching 68 percent. The combined proportion of registered apprenticeship certificates and other trade certificates of electricians was the same as that of plumbers. Hairstylists and barbers had the smallest proportion in the category of high school or less. The proportion of cooks with college or university as their highest education level was lower than that of carpenters.

The graph above displays total consumer expenditures for camping fees and camping equipment in the six Pennsylvania counties in 2014. The Lancaster County population spent the largest amount of money on camping fees and camping equipment. York County spent the second largest amount on camping fees, followed by Berks County. Franklin County spent the smallest amount on camping fees and camping equipment respectively. Three of the six counties spent more than two million dollars on camping equipment. Cumberland spent more on camping fees than Dauphin, but, as for camping equipment, they spent almost the same amount on it.

The graph above shows the percentages of global oil production and consumption in 2015. The Middle East produced the largest percentage of oil, while Asia Pacific consumed the largest percentage of oil. The region that produced the second largest percentage of oil was North America, closely followed by Europe and Eurasia. Africa and South and Central America produced the same percentage of oil, which was under 10%. The percentage of oil consumed by the Middle East was more than twice as large as that consumed by Africa. The smallest percentage point gap between oil production and consumption was found in Europe and Eurasia.

The above graph shows Internet activities of adults by year, 2007, 2015 and 2016 in Great Britain. Of the Internet activities surveyed in 2016, the most popular activity completed online by adults was sending or receiving emails. The second most common Internet activity in 2016 was finding information about goods and services, undertaken by more than 70% of adults, the largest percentage-point increase from 2015. All Internet activities that were surveyed in 2007 and again in 2016 have seen an increase. Reading online news, newspapers or magazines showed the largest percentage-point increase, 60% of adults in 2016, 3 times the proportion doing so in 2007. Internet banking has also seen large increases from 2007, rising about 30 percentage points.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) dropped(떨어진), (B) displays(보여주는), (C) popular(인기 있는) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ① dropped — displays — popular: 원문 그대로
❌ ② risen — displays — popular: risen(상승한)은 dropped의 반의어, 신문 광고 수입은 하락해 바닥에서 두 번째가 됨
❌ ③ dropped — conceals — popular: conceals(숨기는)는 displays(보여주는)의 반의어, 그래프는 지출을 보여줌
❌ ④ dropped — displays — rare: rare(드문)는 popular의 반의어, 이메일이 가장 인기 있는 활동이었음
det.tip: dropped↔risen, displays↔conceals, popular↔rare

det.tip: lower(낮은) ↔ higher(높은). smaller는 크기 축이라 반의어 아님.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>consumed</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: consumed(소비한) ↔ produced(생산한)
det.analysis:
❌ ① used: 사용한, 동의어에 가까움(오답 유도)
✅ ② produced: 생산한, 반의어 (본문에서 produced↔consumed로 직접 대비)
❌ ③ wasted: 낭비한, 소비의 하위 개념이라 반의어 아님
❌ ④ stored: 저장한, 다른 의미축
det.tip: consumed(소비) ↔ produced(생산). 본문 'produced ... while ... consumed'에서 직접 대비됨.

questions.passage:
(A) She <u>spent</u> the whole afternoon reading quietly in the library.

(B) The Lancaster County population <u>spent</u> the largest amount of money on camping fees and camping equipment.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 spent의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) spent = (시간을) 보내다 (오후 내내 독서) / (B) spent = (돈을) 쓰다/지출하다 (가장 많은 금액을 지출)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 시간을 보내다 — (B) 돈을 쓰다: 각 문맥 의미 정확
❌ ② (A) 돈을 쓰다 — (B) 시간을 보내다: 반대로 대입
❌ ③ 둘 다 시간: (B)는 money를 목적어로 받아 '지출'
❌ ④ 둘 다 돈: (A)는 afternoon을 목적어로 받아 '시간을 보냄'
det.tip: spend time(시간을 보내다) vs spend money(돈을 쓰다) — 목적어로 구분.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the income that a company or organization receives regularly, especially from selling goods or services"

det.korean: 회사나 기관이 특히 상품·서비스 판매로 정기적으로 얻는 수입 → revenue(수입/매출)
det.analysis:
❌ ① expenditure: 지출, 수입과 반대
✅ ② revenue: 수입/매출, 정의 일치
❌ ③ shortage: 부족, 무관
❌ ④ donation: 기부금, 정기 판매 수입과 다름
det.tip: revenue = (판매) 수입/매출. advertising revenue = 광고 수입.

questions.passage: The ad revenue of cable TV had increased __________ (steady) since 2005 and became a little less than twice that of radio in 2009.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

The ad revenue of cable TV had increased __________ (steady) since 2005 and became a little less than twice that of radio in 2009.

det.korean: steady(형용사) → steadily(부사): 동사 increased를 수식하므로 부사형으로 변환. '꾸준히 증가했다'.
det.analysis: 동사 increased를 수식하는 자리 → 부사가 필요. steady(형용사) + -ly → steadily(부사). '꾸준히'.
det.tip: 형용사 steady → 부사 steadily (-y를 -ily로). 동사 수식은 부사.

questions.passage: The second most common Internet activity in 2016 was finding information about goods and services, __________ (undertake) by more than 70% of adults, the largest percentage-point increase from 2015.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

The second most common Internet activity in 2016 was finding information about goods and services, __________ (undertake) by more than 70% of adults, the largest percentage-point increase from 2015.

det.korean: undertake(동사원형) → undertaken(과거분사): 'activity ... (which was) undertaken by'의 수동 분사구문. by 70%가 뒤따르므로 수동.
det.analysis: 앞 명사 activity를 수식하는 과거분사(수동). undertake-undertook-undertaken 불규칙 변화. '~에 의해 행해진'.
det.tip: undertake → undertaken (과거분사). 분사+by: 수동 의미.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: changed little(거의 변하지 않았다) — 2009~2013년 라디오 광고 수입은 약 150억 달러로 '거의 그대로 유지'. 'remaining around 15 billion'과 'unlike the other four'로 추론.
det.analysis:
❌ ① grew rapidly: 급성장, '약 150억 유지'와 모순
❌ ② disappeared completely: 완전히 사라짐, 150억이 남아 있음과 모순
❌ ③ doubled every year: 매년 두 배, 유지된 수치와 모순
✅ ④ changed little: 원문 일치 — 다른 네 매체와 달리 거의 변동 없음
det.tip: remaining around 15 billion dollars + unlike the other four → 라디오만 거의 변화 없음.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: high school or less(고졸 이하) — 미용사·이발사는 자격증 비율(68%)이 가장 높았으므로, '고졸 이하'라는 가장 낮은 학력 범주에서는 비율이 가장 작음. 자격증 비율과의 대비로 추론.
det.analysis:
❌ ① registered apprenticeship: 등록 견습, 이들이 가장 높은 범주라 '가장 작은 비율'과 모순
❌ ② college or university: 대학, 글은 cooks·carpenters 비교에만 등장
✅ ③ high school or less: 원문 일치 — 자격증이 많으니 저학력 범주 비율은 최소
❌ ④ advanced graduate degrees: 대학원 학위, 본문에 없는 범주
det.tip: 자격증 비율 최고(68%) → 고졸 이하(저학력) 범주 비율은 최소. 대비 추론.
